name: Model capacity constraints
short_description: Build a quantitative model with at least five capacity constraints and test two feasible scenarios.

description: Build a quantitative model with at least five capacity constraints and test two feasible scenarios. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
